title: Turn Case 001 into a living evidence report
objective: Replace the flat same-size report presentation with a deterministic forensic-editorial evidence composition that makes the verdict, practical meaning, evidence counts, complete root ledger, typed relations, unresolved lineage, terminology, and shareable scoreboard understandable without reducing epistemic precision or changing the accepted dossier.
required_evaluation: complete scoreboard-to-assertion and scoreboard-to-lineage derivation tests
source-closure tests for every displayed finding, relation, qualifier, practical reading, and unresolved item
deterministic share-card content and identity tests
HTML, Markdown, JSON, local API, MCP, and CLI parity tests
no-JavaScript fallback, semantic-heading, keyboard, focus, contrast, and reduced-motion review
desktop and mobile visual inspection at representative narrow and wide viewports
external route, content-type, canonical, share-card, and release-identity read-back after accepted deployment
acceptance: Case 001 reads as a deliberately composed evidence report rather than generic rendered Markdown and uniform bullets
the Stranger Test is defined in one plain sentence near the scoreboard
every scoreboard count links to the complete deterministically derived list it summarizes
the page exposes a compact visible lexicon for apparent support assertion, participant-data root, target-comparable, unresolved lineage, and policy view
a plainly labeled and source-closed practical reading explains what the selected view means for someone writing corrections while preserving the no-universal-practice-rule limitation
relations form a visually sequenced annotated argument and the unresolved 2007 lineage remains first-class
a deterministic share card derives its question, verdict, counts, unresolved marker, dossier identity, and canonical route from the accepted projection
encyclopedia and skeptical first screens remain materially different views of the exact same dossier rather than a cosmetic toggle
the accepted Case 001 dossier, independent receipt, and research packet remain byte-identical
make check passes without changing accepted source state
the accepted Pages deployment passes route, canonical URL, keyboard, mobile, content-type, share-card, and manifest read-back
limitations: This task changes presentation and deterministic projection structure, not the accepted research packet, evidence counts, relation meanings, review receipt, or policy definitions.
The practical reading is a policy-relative interpretation with visible qualifiers, not universal professional or medical advice.
A lexicon reduces terminology cost but does not prove first-time-reader comprehension; real-reader evidence remains future work.
Case 002, a third public lens, additional corpus seeding, hosted API/MCP activation, workflow mutation, DNS changes, publication, and release are out of scope.
